cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Just Say Yes
cards.instruction: Get a quick approval before anyone has time to examine the practical consequences.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Just nod and I'll accept the sofa delivery.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Will it fit through the door?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. We can measure after securing the bargain.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then nod before they start measuring too.

mechanism: A claims expert delivery procedure to rush B acceptance of a sofa before doorway fit can be checked.
confusable: A normal delivery organiser verifies fit before acceptance; A treats measurement as a later task to prevent its practical consequences delaying a yes.
comparison: Garden alternative manages an expiring planning hold; sofa alternative exploits a waiting delivery crew and physical measurement.
seedUse: Sofa outside and doorway fit derive from D28-b; S03 provides handover/installation distinctions rather than merely saying measure later.
